description: This file defines the class 'wsdlcache', which manages caching of WSDL instances, including functions to store, retrieve, create cache filenames, and handle mutex locks for thread safety.

classes.name: wsdlcache
classes.description: A class for caching wsdl instances with methods to add, retrieve, and manage cache files.

methods.name: wsdlcache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes cache directory and lifetime.

methods.name: createFilename
methods.description: Creates a cache filename based on the WSDL URL.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Adds debug information to the class's debug string.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached wsdl instance if available and not expired.

methods.name: obtainMutex
methods.description: Obtains a mutex lock for cache file operations.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a wsdl instance into the cache.

methods.name: releaseMutex
methods.description: Releases the mutex lock for a cache file.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cached wsdl instance from the cache.
